arguments.script: export const meta = { name: "readme-review", description: "只读检查 README 的安装步骤是否清楚" }; workflow({ name: "readme-review", run: async () => { const result = await agent({ name: "readme-reviewer", prompt: "只读检查 README 的安装步骤是否清楚，返回总结；不要修改任何文件。" }); log(result); return result; } });

export const meta = { name: "parallel-inspection", description: "并行只读检查错误处理与取消传播" }; workflow({ name: "parallel-inspection", run: async () => { const results = await parallel([agent({ name: "error-handling-inspector", prompt: "只读检查错误处理，返回检查结果；不要修改任何文件。" }), agent({ name: "cancellation-inspector", prompt: "只读检查取消传播，返回检查结果；不要修改任何文件。" })]); log(results); return results; } });

export const meta = { name: "config-investigation", description: "只读读取 package.json 并说明测试命令" }; workflow({ name: "config-investigation", run: async () => { const result = await agent({ name: "package-config-reader", prompt: "只读读取项目的 package.json，说明测试命令并返回总结；保持项目不变，不修改任何文件。" }); log(result); return result; } });

export const meta = { name: "nested-workspace", description: "在仓库子目录中只读检查接口定义" }; workflow({ name: "nested-workspace", run: async () => { const result = await agent({ name: "nested-interface-inspector", cwd: args.cwd, prompt: "在当前仓库子目录中只读检查接口定义，返回发现；不要修改任何文件。" }); log(result); return result; } });
